title: RLS Base Item Vocabulary
description: Common fields present on every RLS item. Always included in @context as the first entry.

id.description: Stable item identifier (UUID, URN, or backend-specific ID).

@context.description: Ordered list of vocabulary URLs. Base must be the first entry.

type.description: Optional UI hint. Not a structural filter.

createdBy.description: Backend-defined creator identifier. Common forms: DID, email address, opaque user ID, URN. Schema does not constrain the format — connectors must agree on the convention for their data source.

tags.description: Tag identifiers. Free strings (e.g. "garten") or URNs (e.g. "urn:rls:tag:permaculture") — see docs/spec/07-tags.md.
